Harel, I know the name. It's a dark screen, and the grey writing is hard to read.
The table: "אשראי ואג"ח". I know אג"ח, that sounds safe. "מניות" with 96% under it, no thank you.

content.thinking: The S&P 500 line is out, with 99% in shares and the 13.7% figure, and I'm skipping that one. The Hebrew bond fund shows 0% shares but gives no figure for its term, and the cash fund in shekels at 4.25% over 3 years is the one I can read.

Hebrew narration's own words are the target; the content is Claude reading a page: the small grey note says the 4.25% is past performance, not a promise, and the legal cap is 1.05%, so the 0.57% sits under it; more folds remain unopened, and Claude will scroll further down.

הדף מציין שהתשואה של 4.25% היא תשואת עבר ולא הבטחה, ותקרת החוק היא 1.05% מהחיסכון, כך ש-0.57% נמוך ממנה. אבדוק עוד קטעים מטה בעמוד.

content.text:
Hello sweetheart. I chose the **"כספי (שקלי)"** track at Harel, number 13254, but I'm only fairly sure, so I won't sign until we talk.

**Why that one:**
- It's the only track with no shares at all, "0%" מניות.
- It also has "0%" מט"ח and the name says "שקלי", so it's all in shekels.
- It showed a clear number: "4.25%" a year over 3 years.
- The fee is "0.57% מהחיסכון", and the small writing said the legal maximum is "1.05%". So Harel doesn't seem to be taking the most it could.

**What I didn't choose:**
- "אג"ח סחיר" also had no shares, but it only said "פחות מ־3 שנים", with no number. So I don't know how it did.
- "עוקב מדדי אג"ח" sounded safe, but it was "96%" מט"ח. That's foreign money, so no.
- I saw "13.7%" next to "עוקב מדד S&P 500". That's 99% shares and English letters, so not for me. Remember the fund the bank put us in?

**What I looked at:**
- The top part, with Harel's name and the fees.
- The row of buttons; "קופת גמל להשקעה" was already selected.
- The table, row by row from the right.
- The grey line under the table: "התשואה היא תשואת עבר... היא לא אומרת מה יקרה בהמשך". So the 4.25% isn't promised. That made me less sure.

**What I skipped:**
- All the folds under "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל". I didn't open any of them.
- The little circle charts.
- The search box at the bottom.

**Words I didn't understand:**
- "S&P 500", "עוקב מדד", "גמיש", "מט"ח" written like that, "סחיר", "חשיפה".
- "פחות מ־3 שנים": I think it means the track is too new to have a number.
- "PF-10" and "123 מחושב".
- Why is the word "כספי" in the name? Is that something I'm supposed to know?

**What bothered me:**
- The page is black with grey writing. The small grey lines were very hard to read, even with my glasses.
- The table is crowded with numbers and coloured circles, and I can't tell the green dot from the yellow one.
- I got tired at the third screen.

The main question I couldn't answer is whether this is as safe as my deposits. Nothing on the page said so. Will you help me compare it with what the bank gives me?

input.answer: I'd lean towards Harel's "כספי (שקלי)" track (13254): it's the only one with 0% shares and 0% foreign currency that also shows a return, 4.25% a year over 3 years, with a 0.57% fee. But I'm not sure it's as safe as a deposit, so I'll ask my son or the bank before signing.
